hints.title: Vertical Slice Decomposition
hints.text: Divide the 2D plane into vertical strips bounded by unique horizontal coordinates.

hints.title: Filter Overlapping Strips
hints.text: For each strip [x1, x2], gather all rectangles that span across the strip horizontally.

hints.title: One-Dimensional Interval Merging
hints.text: Merge overlapping vertical segments inside the strip to find the total height, then add height times width modulo 10^9 + 7.

hints.title: See the blueprint
hints.text:
```python
from typing import List

class Solution:
    def rectangleArea(self, rectangles: List[List[int]]) -> int:
        MOD = 1_000_000_007
        xs = sorted(list(set([r[0] for r in rectangles] + [r[2] for r in rectangles])))
        total_area = 0

        for i in range(len(xs) - 1):
            x1, x2 = xs[i], xs[i + 1]
            width = x2 - x1
            intervals = []
            for rx1, ry1, rx2, ry2 in rectangles:
                if rx1 <= x1 and rx2 >= x2:
                    intervals.append((ry1, ry2))
            intervals.sort()
            covered_y = 0
            cur_bottom = -1
            for y1, y2 in intervals:
                cur_bottom = max(cur_bottom, y1)
                if y2 > cur_bottom:
                    covered_y += y2 - cur_bottom
                    cur_bottom = y2
            total_area = (total_area + covered_y * width) % MOD

        return total_area
```

complexity.notes: Coordinate slicing with 1D vertical interval merging per slice.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Discrete pixel grid allocation overflows memory for coordinates up to 10^9.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Unique coordinate boundaries and 1D interval list require O(N) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Coordinate compression with sweep-line or vertical slice merging.
